title: DTC 34 Turbo Pressure Malfunction
ocr_text:
EG–546
ENGINE – 2JZ–GTE ENGINE TROUBLESHOOTING

DTC 34 Turbo Pressure Malfunction

CIRCUIT DESCRIPTION

To control maximum turbocharging pressure the turbocharger system includes a waste gate valve controlled by an actuator. The actuator is controlled by the manifold pressure which is duty controlled by the VSV based on signals from the ECM.
If the ECM detects the below diagnosis conditions, it operates the fail safe function in which the ECM stops fuel injection.

ECM
VSV for Waste Gate Valve
Waste Gate Valve
Air Cleaner
Actuator

FI6974

DTC No. | Diagnostic Trouble Code Detecting Condition | Trouble Area

34
All conditions below are detected continuously for 2 sec. or more:
(a) Manifold absolute pressure:
200 kPa (2.0 kgf/cm², 29 psi) or more
(b) Throttle valve opening angle:
20° or more
(c) Engine speed: 2,400 rpm or more
• Actuator (for waste gate valve)
• Short in VSV for waste gate valve circuit
• ECM
